C0410.title: Uber 2022 MFA Fatigue Attack Incident
C0410.summary: In September 2022, Uber disclosed a security incident in which an attacker bought credentials for an external contractor account and repeatedly triggered MFA login requests. The contractor eventually approved one request, giving the attacker access to internal Uber systems. Uber said the incident was linked to Lapsus$ and found no evidence that user accounts or sensitive user data were accessed.

references.title: Uber says Lapsus$ behind cyberattack, no user data exposed
